name: Cheval Blanc Paris
insider_take: This ultra-luxe palace hotel sits majestically on the banks of the Seine, occupying the former La Samaritaine department store with breathtaking views of the Louvre and Pont Neuf.
whats_special: Cheval Blanc Paris houses the world's only Dior Spa and features interiors by acclaimed architect Peter Marino. The hotel's rooftop terrace offers unparalleled 360-degree views of Paris landmarks, while Chef Arnaud Donckele's restaurant has earned three Michelin stars in record time.
pro_tip: Book the Dior Spa's signature "Or Rouge" treatment using the brand's exclusive skincare line, and time your rooftop cocktail for golden hour to capture Instagram-worthy shots of the Eiffel Tower and Notre-Dame.
dont_miss: The hotel's private art collection curated by renowned gallery owner Emmanuel Perrotin, featuring works by contemporary masters. Take a stroll across Pont Neuf (literally steps away) at sunset, or explore the renovated La Samaritaine shopping complex directly connected to the hotel.
pros: Exceptional location in the heart of Paris with views of the Seine and Louvre
Ultra-luxury accommodations with bespoke LVMH craftsmanship and design
World-class dining including Michelin-starred restaurant Plénitude
Exclusive Dior Spa offering premium wellness treatments
cons: Intimate boutique size with limited availability
